name: Нulkamania Wrestling
summary:
When professional wrestling itself is threatened by Darkness, the only hope is for the sport's immortal hero, Hulk Hogan, to return to the ring and set things right. Join the Hulkster in the ring for the wildest wrestling contest ever. Get ready for an intense and spectacular fight against 7 outrageous wrestlers.

Hit 'em with a Head Splitter, dodge the opponent's clothesline, then finish them off with the Big Foot. Once he's down for good, go for the pin and: ONE, TWO, THREE, DING! Victory is yours, at least until your next match...
